links.outcome: Reporting time and report quality with versus without GPT-4 assistance
links.effect: Total and case reporting times decreased with AI assistance but not significantly (p>0.05); quality of finalized reports comparable with no significant differences. Time excluding editing was significantly lower (p<0.05).
links.quote: Quality scores of the finalized reports with and without AI-assistance were comparable with no significant differences.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to convert free-text radiology reports into structured reports

screen.reason: Empirical study testing a GPT-4-powered tool for converting free-text radiology reports to structured reports by radiologists, evaluating turnaround time and report quality, without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
